forwardView: 18 months out: Fed hiking toward 4.4% (market pricing) into already-restrictive real rates with M2 surging 10-12%. This is a policy error risk — you can't hike to 4.4% without breaking something. Two scenarios: (a) inflation stays sticky, Fed keeps hiking → dollar stronger near-term, risk assets pressured, gold eventually wins on inflation debasement; (b) economy cracks, Fed forced to pivot → dollar weakens, risk assets rally, gold also wins. Either way, gold wins 18 months out but TIMING is premature (broke $3,950 support, needs $3,800 washout or $4,000 reclaim). NEAR TERM (3-6 months): dollar strength dominates. EUR short is the cleanest expression. Patience on longs — wait for the crack or the washout. Cash is a position.
